assessments.reasoning: At each non-null environment the algorithm calls HasBinding. A match immediately makes that environment the reference base. A miss continues at its outer environment with the same name and strict flag. At null it constructs an unresolvable reference. The operation constructs a reference without fetching the binding’s value.

challenge.method: Trace a shadowed name, an initially null environment, and an abrupt HasBinding call.
challenge.results: The inner match ends the search before the shadowed binding is visited. An initially null environment yields an unresolvable reference without a lookup. An abrupt HasBinding propagates under the algorithm and is excluded by the claim’s normal-completion condition.

limitations: This is the abstract reference-creation algorithm. It does not read an environment binding's value or decide every later use of the returned reference.
The result describes reference selection. A selected binding can have additional conditions on when its value may be read.
